name: How do I choose the right type of rental property (e.g., single-family, condo, multi-family)?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right type of rental property (e.g., single-family, condo, multi-family)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right rental property type depends on your investment goals, risk tolerance, and desired level of involvement. Single-family homes often attract families seeking stability, while condos can appeal to individuals or couples desiring amenities and less exterior maintenance. Multi-family properties typically offer higher cash flow potential but may require more intensive management. A key decision factor involves assessing the local tenant demand for each property type in your target market, such as the strong condo market in areas like Aventura or Brickell.
